sources.title: Bilbao: official SAM help
sources.note: Methodological basis for mechanical representations, Γ-point symmetry-adapted modes, and IR/Raman activity. The site's worked examples, questions, and derivations are original.

sources.title: IUCr：An Introduction to Crystal Physics，Ervin Hartmann
sources.note: Sections 2–4 distinguish tensor transformations, intrinsic index symmetries, and crystal symmetry. Equilibrium and  transport  responses have different applicability conditions.

sources.title: Bilbao: official MTENSOR help
sources.note: Background on tensor constraints from magnetic point groups; this classroom independently derives static linear magnetoelectric response using polar/axial character and time-reversal parity.

sources.title: Etxebarria et al.: Crystal tensor properties of magnetic materials with and without spin–orbit coupling (2025)
sources.note: Illustrates the different regimes of constraints from magnetic point groups and from spin point groups when spin–orbit coupling is neglected. These exercises specify only a magnetic point group; they do not determine the magnetic order of a real material.

sources.title: AFLOW: diamond (A4) structure prototype
sources.note: Verify Si  diamond structure , No.227, and the two-atom  primitive cell .

sources.title: AFLOW: zincblende (B3) structure prototype
sources.note: Verifies GaAs zinc blende, No.216, and inversion absence due to chemically distinct occupations.

sources.title: AFLOW: Rock Salt/Halite (NaCl, B1) structure prototype
sources.note: Check the rock-salt structure of NaCl, No.225, and its two fcc sublattices.

scope: The phonon module treats Γ-point symmetry-adapted displacements and first-order optical selection rules; symmetry alone does not give force constants, phonon frequencies, or actual spectral intensities.
The tensor module derives static equilibrium response forms under specified  point group  constraints. Allowed components can still vanish in a particular material for microscopic reasons.

Si, GaAs and NaCl use ideal cubic structures from the material atlas. Animation amplitudes, spectral peak centers and linewidths are demonstration parameters, not experimental or first-principles data.
